semantic_review.finding: Equality_Model caches eq and conditionally unitEq. Valid and Selection are distinct equations. Invalid/nonboolean eq yields (False,0). Non-attach arbitrary Op retains helper semantics: Boolean eq valid, selection determined by captured Is_True. There is no new operation-domain restriction.

Matched attach with missing/null/nonboolean unitEq remains (False,1); true/false Boolean unitEq yields (True,2)/(True,1). Unmatched attach accepts explicit JSON null only, with selection0; missing/non-null remains invalid. This preserves the operational partial write that future fold/Plan bridge must carry into Matches/Position before failure.

Row_Model rejects nonobjects; non-reconcile operations retain left/right/operatorResult object-shape validation. Release uses ne independently of eq, validates Boolean shape and selects only Is_False. Reconcile skips equality structural fields, requires literalFalse Boolean and original object, and selects captured literalFalse truth without coercing original-state truth.

Only supported equality operations delegate Row_Model to Equality_Model; unknown operation yields invalid0 after unchanged shape check. Equality_Model alone intentionally covers a wider arbitrary-Op helper domain. Do not equate it directly to declarative Row_Selection for unsupported operations.

New exact record-equality Posts constrain both Valid and Selection on every normal return; neither uses an implication that hides invalid/partial cases. Models do not call the function they specify, so these are noncircular functional obligations, not executable-body aliases. Their truth remains UNPROVED until strict proof.

Zero_Result,Replay_Rows,Conforms and all preexisting helpers/branches remain byte-identical. First-invalid suffix behavior, Matches/Last_Match updates, ordinal-to-Mask indexing, null-domain handling and terminal codes are unchanged source, not newly established semantics.

No new Pre or cap narrows Node,Data,Op or public Conforms domain. Field retains last-key-wins traversal and Is_True/Is_False retain literal-Boolean observation. Complete case coverage is a total-specification intent; selector/model AoRTE and termination for all representable cached Nodes, plus parser-established reachability at public callers, remain unproved.
